neural_requirement.name: Neural Controller Soundness
neural_requirement.raw_expression:
(p.targetSpeed > p.currentSpeedMps + toleranceMps and p.gapMeters >= safeFollowingDistanceMeters == p.driveForce > onThreshold) and
                (p.targetSpeed < p.currentSpeedMps - toleranceMps or p.gapMeters < safeFollowingDistanceMeters == p.driveForce < (0 - onThreshold)) and
                (p.driveForce >= (0 - 100) and p.driveForce <= 100)

theorem_gate.profile_theorem_statement: Within the extracted strict-Q syntactic semantics, the selected finite buffer reconstructs q and determines observations, requirement statuses, reward, done, and exact shield execution as recorded in mdp_obligations.
theorem_gate.solver_backed_theorem_statement: Within the extracted equation semantics and stated solver fragment, the selected buffer is a sufficient Markov state for the transition-closed relevant state, visible outputs, reward, done, and shielded executed action.

solver_backed_uniqueness.theorem_statement: No two one-step executions of the extracted equation model can agree on current q and executed action while disagreeing on next q, next observations, next terminal equations, or next requirement status equations.
